name: @lacspace/mail-classify
description: Fast, explainable email categoriser for webmail inboxes: tags a message with one of 10 categories (team, clients, personal, finance, calendar, newsletters, notifications, recruiting, social, promotions) and a high/normal/low priority from sender, recipients, subject, preview and optional List-*/Auto-Submitted/Precedence/Content-Type headers. No body fetch, no AI call, returns the reasons that fired. Every pattern and the category labels/colours are exported and overridable. Zero dependencies, isomorphic.
author: Lacspace <contact@lacspace.com>
